name: mgt-quoting
description: For insurance agents: quote MGT small-business commercial insurance from ChatGPT. Check appetite, classify the business, and create and edit quotes.

interface.longDescription: MGT Quoting is for insurance agents who quote small-business commercial insurance with MGT Insurance. ChatGPT checks whether MGT writes a business, picks the right classification, and creates and edits quotes for MGT products such as Business Owner Policy, specialty general liability, specialty property, and farm. Results can be wrong: a licensed person must review every quote, and binding happens in Shadowfax, MGT's agent portal, not in ChatGPT. Available to accounts outside MGT that hold the quote:create access granted by MGT.
defaultPrompt: Does MGT write a bakery in Austin, Texas?
Create a Business Owner Policy quote for a 3-person dental office.
Classify a mobile dog grooming business for MGT.
